data.gender_notes: Ishavasya is used as a unisex name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ishavasya is recorded with the meaning “Supreme Lord of the Universe”. Ishavasya is a Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. name meaning “Supreme Lord of the Universe”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. in_sanskrit.name: ईशावास्य
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name of the Lord who is the indweller of all beings and things.

in_hindi.name: ईशावास्य
in_hindi.long_meaning: सबका स्वामी वह परमेश्वर है जो सभी प्राणियों और वस्तुओं में निवास करता है।

in_tamil.name: ஈஷாவாஸ்ய
in_tamil.long_meaning: அனைத்து அடிப்படையில் இறைவன் அவன் என்று அனைத்து பிறவியிலுள்ள பிறவியின் இறைவனாகும்.

in_telugu.name: ఈశావాస్య
in_telugu.long_meaning: సర్వంధర్మదేవుడు అని అది అన్ని దృష్టియలలో దేవుడు అంటూ అందరింద సమూహం కలిగించుతుందో అది అని అనువర్తించిన పేరు.

in_marathi.name: Ishavasya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Supreme Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ishavasya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ishavasya is a name for the supreme lord of the universe, often personified as Lord Vishnu or Lord Shiva in Hindu mythology.

in_bengali.name: Ishavasya
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Supreme Lord of the Universe
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ishavasya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Ishavasya is a name for the supreme lord of the universe, often personified as Lord Vishnu or Lord Shiva in Hindu mythology.
